<h3>Cómo se lee la clasificación</h3><ul:
How to read the leaderboard

  • R1, R2…: shots in each round; with an asterisk, those recorded by hand.
  • Gross: the total shots.
  • Net: gross minus the handicap in each round played.
  • To par: the net compared with the par of the rounds played; it decides the leaderboard (−3 is ahead of +2). That way someone with more rounds can be compared with someone with fewer.
  • Tie: the best last net round wins.
